messages:
rachael (marketing): Quick heads up — registration is live for the April benchmark webinar. Need a final preflight on Zoom config, captions, recording destination, and HubSpot lead routing. can we run a 15m smoke today?

tomas (growth): +1 for a quick smoke. main asks: ensure SRT captions, cloud recording to our S3 bucket, and UTMs on confirmation link so leads get the right campaign tag.

mike (events-ops): I can take the Zoom side. Plan: Cloud recording -> cloud video + audio transcript ON, auto-captioning OFF (we use SRT from vendor). Enable alternative host for backup. What S3 path do we want?

sara (content): We also need to make sure the post-event email has the short clip CTA + transcript link. Tag clips with speaker and segment for nurture flows.

devin (analytics): For HubSpot, route registrant and attendee webhooks to /integrations/hubspot/webinar with payload including utm_source, utm_campaign, and session_id. We should add a lead property: webinar_segment=benchmark_apr.

mike (events-ops): S3 path: s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-benchmark/. I'll set retention = 90 days default, with vault copy to long-term bucket for edits.

sara (content): For captions: vendor SRT output -> transcription pipeline -> human QC. We should also attach a short excerpt (60s) for social. Who owns clip selection? @sara.

tomas (growth): Routing rules: if attendee=YES and watch_time>=300s => cadence = sales-touch-1; else => nurture-demo-sequence. Devin pls confirm HubSpot property names.

devin (analytics): Confirmed: hs_event_watch_time, hs_attended, and custom property webinar_segment. I'll add a workflow that tags lead score + creates activity.

mike (events-ops): Zoom config checklist (quick):
- Cloud recording: ON -> Record active speaker + gallery + shared screen
- Alternative host: mike@redwood.com
- Live transcription: OFF (we ingest SRT)
- Closed captions: send API to captions vendor (instructions below)
- Record to cloud and AUTOMATICALLY copy to S3 via zapier lambda

Commands (for runbook):
```
# webhook to start S3 copy after recording appears
POST /recordings/notify
{ "meeting_id": "{{meetingId}}", "recording_url": "{{downloadUrl}}" }
```

rachael (marketing): mike — can you add the captions vendor webhook URL and creds to the secure runbook? Also confirm the transcript turn-around (expected).

mike (events-ops): Will add. vendor ETA = 6-8 hours for draft SRT, 24h for human-checked final. For speed edits, we will produce 60s highlight within 12h.

sara (content): OK. I'll prep the post-event email copy and 3 clip timestamps preselected during the event. Also need alt text for clips for accessibility.

tomas (growth): Small ask — add an explicit opt-in checkbox on the reg page for vendor transcripts & clip reuse. Legal wants explicit consent.

rachael (marketing): Good call. Add checkbox text: "I consent to receive post-event materials, recordings, and related marketing."

zoom-bot: Cloud recording for meeting 987-654-321 started at 2026-04-15T17:00:00Z.

devin (analytics): Smoke plan for today at 16:30 PT:
- join as host & alt host
- trigger recording start/stop
- ensure recording appears in cloud
- webhook fires and S3 copy completes (check object checksum)
- vendor receives recording notification and posts SRT to vendor endpoint
- HubSpot receives registrant webhook with UTM and session_id

mike (events-ops): I'll run the smoke at 16:30PT and paste logs here. if anything fails, we'll fall back to manual download + upload process.

sara (content): I'll be on to check clips and start social creatives.

rachael (marketing): Thanks team — if smoke is green we go live. Post-smoke, mike drop the runbook link and DEVIN add the HubSpot workflow ID. :thumbsup:
